_source: Gate 7 (ADU-MOB-01 v1.2 S18.1 row 7, S16, S5.1). The catalogue keys a MOBILE session renders are mobile.*, common.* and the error.* set the API sends as message_key. An error.* key whose shared string legitimately carries console language is listed here with the mobile.* key WO-1's error mapper must render instead; gate 7 skips the listed key, scans its replacement as a mobile key, and fails if a listed key no longer exists in en.ts. Adding a row here is a deliberate edit with a reason, reviewed like a dependency.

overrides.why: ADU-MOB-01 S5.1: to a MOBILE session TIER_LIMIT_REACHED names the capability and where it is configured and never the tier; the shared string says 'plan', which the console may say and the app may not.
